newsitem.title: USA: Chairman holds 20.3 pct stake in CNET.
newsitem.headline: Chairman holds 20.3 pct stake in CNET.

text.p: Halsey Minor, chairman, chief executive and president of CNET Inc, said Thursday he holds a 20.3 percent stake or 2,694,564 common shares in the company.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Minor said his stake includes 13,600 shares he bought between August 26 and 30. He did not state the purchase price for the shares.
Minor said he holds the stake for personal investment purposes.
CNET is a San Francisco-based company developing Internet programming for its Web sites and cable TV shows.
